habitat: Temperate forests; subtropical/tropical moist montane forests; open woodland; forest edge; and gardens
story: Few birds capture the imagination quite like the Green Tailed Sunbird (Aethopyga nipalensis). As a member of the Nectariniidae family, it has carved out a unique niche in Temperate forests; subtropical/tropical moist montane forests; open woodland; forest edge; and gardens. Its conservation status is Least Concern (LC), a classification that drives crucial research and protection efforts. The Green Tailed Sunbird's presence is a vital sign of its ecosystem's health, making its preservation a priority. This poster is a tribute to the Green Tailed Sunbird, celebrating its role in the natural world and inspiring a deeper appreciation for biodiversity.
